verifyNote: Reference templates. Use the site and client permit procedure where it differs. Verify laws before audit use.

general_conditions: The permit must be displayed at the work site
Work only within the scope, place and time written on the permit
Stop work and hand in the permit if conditions change or an alarm sounds
The permit ends at the expiry time or the end of the shift, whichever is first
Re-validate with a new check at shift change and after any long break
Contractors follow the site permit procedure and the client rules
revalidation: Check the area, isolations and gas test again before restart
Both receiver and issuer sign the revalidation with date and time
Re-brief the crew on the JSA and emergency arrangements
common.notice: The official site permit-to-work procedure and the client permit forms always take priority. This is a starting template.

types.title: Hot Work Permit
types.description: Welding, cutting, grinding or any work that makes sparks, flame or heat.

precautions.text: Valid hot work permit for this exact place and time
Combustibles removed or covered within 11 m (35 ft), including below and behind the work
Floor and wall openings covered, sprinklers in service
Gas test done and recorded where flammable vapour or gas may be present
Fire extinguisher of the right type within reach
Trained fire watch assigned for the work and for at least 30 minutes after it ends
Ventilation or fume extraction in place
Gas cylinders upright and secured, hoses and regulators checked, flashback arrestors fitted
Electrical welding equipment inspected, earth return close to the work
Workers briefed on the JSA and the emergency alarm

gas_test.note: Typical values. Use your site standard. Retest after any break or change.

handback: Work finished and area left tidy
Hot materials cooled or marked
Cylinders and equipment removed or secured
Fire watch completed the full post-work watch with a final check
Permit closed by receiver, then issuer
ppe: Welding helmet with correct shade (EN 175 / EN 379, ANSI Z87.1)
Flame-resistant welding clothing and apron (EN ISO 11611)
Respirator for the fume (EN 149 FFP3 or P100) or PAPR

legal.india: Factories Act 1948 and state rules; IS 818 (safety in electric and gas welding and cutting); BOCW Central Rules 1998 on construction sites (verify current OSH Code status)
legal.gulf: UAE Cabinet Decision No. 33 of 2020; UAE Fire and Life Safety Code of Practice; client hot work procedures such as ADNOC and Aramco (verify)
legal.canada: CSA W117.2 (safety in welding, cutting and allied processes); provincial OHS regulations (verify province)
legal.usa: OSHA 29 CFR 1910 Subpart Q (1910.251-.255); 29 CFR 1926 Subpart J (1926.350-.354); NFPA 51B

types.title: Confined Space Entry Permit
types.description: Entry into tanks, vessels, pits, manholes and other confined or enclosed spaces.

precautions.text: Valid entry permit displayed at the entrance
Pipes, power and moving parts isolated and locked
Atmosphere tested at all levels for oxygen, flammable and toxic gas and recorded
Ventilation running
Trained attendant stationed at the entrance at all times, entrants logged
Communication between entrants and attendant tested
Rescue plan, equipment and trained rescuers ready and not dependent on entry
Entrants trained, authorised and fit
Lighting and equipment suitable for the atmosphere
No hot work inside unless a separate hot work permit is also issued

gas_test.note: Typical values. Test top, middle and bottom. Monitor continuously or retest as the site procedure requires.

handback: Everyone is out and counted
Tools and materials removed
Space closed and secured against entry
Isolations restored only by the isolating authority
Permit closed by receiver, then issuer
ppe: Personal multi-gas detector, calibrated and bump tested
Harness with retrieval line (EN 361, EN 1496 rescue lifting device)
Breathing apparatus or airline where required (EN 137, EN 14594)
Helmet, safety boots and coverall suited to the residues

legal.india: Factories Act 1948 s.36 (dangerous fumes) and state rules; BOCW Central Rules 1998 (verify)
legal.gulf: UAE Cabinet Decision No. 33 of 2020; ADNOC and Aramco confined space procedures; for ships IMO Resolution A.1050(27) (verify)
legal.canada: Provincial confined space regulations (for example Ontario Reg. 632/05, WorkSafeBC OHS Regulation Part 9); CSA Z1006
legal.usa: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.146 (permit-required confined spaces); 29 CFR 1926 Subpart AA; shipyards 29 CFR 1915 Subpart B; ships SOLAS and IMO A.1050(27)

types.title: Work at Height Permit
types.description: Work where a person could fall: roofs, edges, platforms, ladders and openings.

precautions.text: Ground-level or platform alternative considered first
Guardrails, covers or nets in place where possible
Anchor points rated and checked, harness and lanyard inspected and fitted
Rescue plan and trained rescuers ready
Fragile surfaces identified, marked and covered
Weather acceptable: no high wind, rain, lightning or ice
Area below barricaded and signed
Tools and materials secured against dropping
Scaffold or MEWP tagged and inspected, ladders sound
Workers trained and fit to work at height

gas_test.note: No gas test required unless the work area changes.

handback: Work complete and area tidy
Temporary edge protection or covers left safe or removed by authorised people
Equipment removed or secured
Permit closed by receiver, then issuer
ppe: Full body harness (EN 361) with energy absorber (EN 355)

legal.india: BOCW Central Rules 1998; Factories Act 1948 and state rules; IS 3521 (industrial safety belts and harnesses) (verify)
legal.gulf: UAE Cabinet Decision No. 33 of 2020; client standards; EN 363 fall protection systems commonly specified (verify)
legal.canada: CSA Z259 series (fall protection) and provincial OHS regulations, which set the height trigger
legal.usa: OSHA 29 CFR 1926 Subpart M (1926.501); 29 CFR 1910 Subpart D (1910.28)

types.title: Excavation Permit
types.description: Digging trenches, pits and foundations and any ground disturbance.

precautions.text: Utilities located, scanned and marked before digging
Protective system (shoring, box or sloping) in place for trenches 1.5 m (5 ft) or deeper unless in stable rock
Ladder or ramp so no one has more than 7.5 m (25 ft) to travel to exit
Edge barriers in place and spoil and equipment set back at least 0.6 m (2 ft)
Atmosphere tested if deep, near contamination or fuel
Water controlled and pumped if present
Competent person inspected the excavation today and after rain
Vehicles and plant segregated from the edge
Overhead lines and services above ground considered
Emergency rescue arrangements known

gas_test.note: Required if the trench is deep or near contamination. Use your site standard.

handback: Backfilled or secured with barriers and signs
Utilities left undamaged
Equipment removed
Permit closed by receiver, then issuer
ppe: Gas detector for deep or suspect trenches

legal.india: BOCW Central Rules 1998; IS 3764 (excavation work code of safety) (verify)
legal.gulf: UAE Cabinet Decision No. 33 of 2020; utility authority approvals and client permit to dig (verify)
legal.canada: Provincial construction regulations (for example WorkSafeBC OHS Regulation Part 20, Ontario Reg. 213/91)

types.title: Electrical Isolation (LOTO) Permit
types.description: Work on electrical equipment that must be isolated, locked and proven dead.

precautions.text: Worker qualified and authorised for this equipment
All energy sources identified and isolation points listed
Personal lock and tag fitted at every isolation point
Stored energy released (capacitors, springs, pressure)
Tested dead with a proven tester: test, prove, test
Barriers and warning signs set
Arc flash boundary and PPE category confirmed
Live work only if justified and separately authorised
Insulated tools and rated PPE available
Temporary earths fitted where required

gas_test.note: No gas test required unless the work area changes.

handback: Work complete, tools and materials removed
Guards and covers refitted
Everyone clear of the equipment
Each lock removed by the person who fitted it
Equipment re-energised and tested
Permit closed
ppe: Arc-rated clothing and face shield (IEC 61482-2, NFPA 70E)
Insulating gloves with leather protectors (IEC 60903, ASTM D120)
Dielectric safety boots (EN ISO 20345 or ASTM F2413 EH)

legal.india: CEA (Measures relating to Safety and Electric Supply) Regulations; Indian Electricity Rules 1956 where applicable (verify)
legal.gulf: UAE Cabinet Decision No. 33 of 2020; local utility regulations (DEWA, SEWA, Kahramaa, SEC) and client LOTO standards (verify)
legal.canada: CSA Z460 (control of hazardous energy) and CSA Z462 (workplace electrical safety); provincial regulations
legal.usa: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.147 (LOTO), 1910.333 (work practices), 1910 Subpart S; 1926 Subpart K; NFPA 70E

types.title: Cold Work Permit
types.description: Maintenance and other hazardous work with no heat or ignition source.

precautions.text: Job described and JSA completed
Area barricaded and signed
Other work nearby (SIMOPS) checked and compatible
Housekeeping acceptable, escape routes clear
Tools and equipment inspected
Lifting and manual handling controls in place
PPE for the task identified and available
Emergency arrangements and alarm briefed

gas_test.note: No gas test required unless the work area changes.

handback: Work complete and area tidy
Tools removed
Equipment left in a safe state
Permit closed by receiver, then issuer

legal.india: Factories Act 1948 and state rules; site permit-to-work procedure (verify)
legal.gulf: UAE Cabinet Decision No. 33 of 2020; client permit-to-work procedures (verify)
legal.canada: Provincial OHS regulations; employer permit-to-work procedure
legal.usa: OSHA General Duty Clause; site permit procedure; 29 CFR 1910.147 where energy control applies

types.title: Line Breaking / Intrusive Work Permit
types.description: Opening pipes, flanges or equipment that may contain hazardous fluids.

precautions.text: Positive isolation (double block and bleed or blinds) verified by a second competent person
Line depressurised, drained and purged as planned
Contents and SDS known, right line confirmed against the isolation list
Gas test done and recorded
Ignition sources controlled
Spill containment and drip trays in place
Bolt loosening sequence controlled, stand clear of the first release
Wind direction and escape route known
Emergency response and fire fighting arrangements ready
PPE chosen from the SDS

gas_test.note: Typical values. Use your site standard. Retest if conditions change.

handback: Joint remade, tightened and leak tested
Blinds removed and recorded
Isolations restored only by the isolating authority
Area cleaned, spills cleared
Permit closed by receiver, then issuer
ppe: Escape breathing apparatus where H2S is possible (EN 13794)

legal.india: Factories Act 1948 Chapter IVA; MSIHC Rules 1989 (verify)
legal.gulf: ADNOC and Aramco process isolation and permit standards (client documents) and UAE Cabinet Decision No. 33 of 2020 (verify)
legal.canada: Provincial regulations and CSA Z767 (process safety management)
